projects.name: Data center retail agreements on two NRG-owned Texas sites
projects.quote: NRG has entered into 295 MW of premium, long-term retail agreements to power data centers constructed on two NRG-owned sites in Texas.

projects.name: T.H. Wharton generation facility
projects.quote: On July 31, 2025, NRG entered into a $216 million loan agreement with the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) under the TEF for a low-interest rate loan at 3% to support development at its 415 MW (456 MW nameplate) T.H. Wharton generation facility.

projects.name: Greens Bayou
projects.quote: NRG has two additional Texas new build projects in TEF due diligence review, Greens Bayou and Cedar Bayou, totaling 1.1 GW.

projects.name: Cedar Bayou

projects.name: LS Power natural gas-fired generation portfolio acquisition
projects.quote: On May 12, 2025, NRG entered into a definitive agreement with LS Power to acquire a power portfolio including 13 GW of natural gas-fired generation facilities and a Commercial & Industrial Virtual Power Plant platform with 6 GW of capacity.

projects.name: Texas Residential Virtual Power Plant
projects.quote: Building on strong customer adoption of the Home Essentials and other offerings, NRG has raised its 2025 Texas Residential Virtual Power Plant target to 150 MW, up from 20 MW.
